title: Server settings
text:
# Server settings

## Concurrency

background_pool_size sets the number of threads performing background merges and mutations for tables with the MergeTree engine. The default value is 16.

max_concurrent_queries limits how many queries are processed simultaneously. The default value is 100.

## Timeouts

distributed_ddl_task_timeout controls how long the server waits for a distributed DDL task. The default value is 180 seconds.

## Limits

| setting | default | scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| background_pool_size | 16 | server |
| max_concurrent_queries | 100 | server |
| distributed_ddl_task_timeout | 180 | server |

title: MergeTree engine
text:
# MergeTree engine

## Parts

A part is an immutable set of files on disk holding a sorted range of rows. Parts are never modified in place; a merge replaces several parts with one.

## Deduplication

replicated_deduplication_window sets how many recent insert blocks are remembered for deduplication on a replicated table.

```sql
CREATE TABLE t (id UInt64) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree
```

title: Ingestion pipeline
text:
# Ingestion pipeline

## Batches

Inserts are buffered into blocks before they are written. A block has a maximum size controlled by min_insert_block_size_rows and min_insert_block_size_bytes.

## Backpressure

When too many parts accumulate, the server throttles inserts and reports the Too many parts error.

title: Query pipeline
text:
# Query pipeline

## Reading

Queries read from parts through the storage layer, using primary key indexes to skip ranges that cannot match.

## Concurrency limits

max_concurrent_queries applies per server unless the user profile overrides it.
